title: Hanuman Vs Mahiravana
overview: A series of events leading up to the final confrontation between Rama and Ravana. During the battle, Rama and Lakshmana are captured by Mahiravana, an evil sorcerer who is the brother and ally of Ravana.

songs.title: Tum Kho Gaye
songs.singers: Hanuman Vs Mahiravana, Shudeep, Krishnamurthy, Shivaprasad, Bakiyaraj

songs.title: Veer Vaanar
songs.singers: Hanuman Vs Mahiravana, Jithin, Pop Shalini
